description: This file defines a custom exception class TaxComponentNotFoundException for the Fineract project, specifically in the tax portfolio module. It extends a base exception class and is raised when a tax component with a given ID is not found.

classes.name: TaxComponentNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a tax component with a specific ID was not found in the system.

methods.name: TaxComponentNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating an invalid tax component ID.
